siblings.title: Day-trips and activities within 30 km of Cuchara
siblings.summary: Bosland-anchored cycling, the Achel abbey, plus an honest map of what's actually inside the 30 km circle around Jan Tournier's two-Michelin-star restaurant — and what isn't.

siblings.title: Walking-distance lodging at or near Cuchara
siblings.summary: Hotel Corbie at ~150 m and Mi Casa Naranja at ~4 min walk are the only true walk-back-from-dinner options; Cuchara's other two recommendations are taxi territory.

siblings.title: Special-character lodging within taxi range of Cuchara
siblings.summary: Five characterful stays inside a one-taxi hop of Cuchara: a 1904 engineer's villa, a Sahara-edge B&B, a forest-fringe boutique hotel, a Bosland glamping tent and a 1957 farm in Pelt.

siblings.title: IT conferences and tech events within 30 km of Cuchara
siblings.summary: A 30 km circle around Cuchara (Lommel) sweeps in Eindhoven's Brainport hub — nearly every IT-relevant event in the radius runs there. Hasselt/Genk fall just outside.

sources.title: Cuchara — Restaurant info
sources.claim: Cuchara is at Lepelstraat 3, 3920 Lommel, on a pedestrian street; restaurant explicitly recommends Corbiehotel (walking distance), B&B 't Wilgenhuys and B&B Ars Vivendi; suggested parking at Adelbergpark 1 or Hertog Janplein; Taxi Flament listed.

sources.title: MICHELIN Guide — Cuchara
sources.claim: Cuchara holds Two MICHELIN Stars in the 2026 MICHELIN Guide Belgium under chef Jan Tournier.

sources.title: Visit Lommel — Cuchara detail
sources.claim: Cuchara sits in a stately family building on Lepelstraat; dining room moved into the rear building in 2015.

sources.title: Hotel Corbie Lommel — official
sources.claim: Hotel Corbie Lommel is at Hertog Janplein 68 (Lommel city hall square) and has 35 modern rooms and studios.

sources.title: TripAdvisor — Corbie Hotel Lommel
sources.claim: Hotel Corbie Lommel: 3.4/5 (68 reviews), $196-$205/night standard, breakfast praised, central location with free parking; explicitly walking distance to Cuchara.

sources.title: Expedia — Hotel Corbie Lommel
sources.claim: Hotel Corbie is described as a 3-star hotel 0.1 miles (0.2 km) from Lommel center, with 33 accommodations and rated 8.0/10 across 549 reviews; free overnight parking on the square directly outside.

sources.title: Mi Casa Naranja — official
sources.claim: Mi Casa Naranja: Molsekiezel 24, 3920 Lommel; three luxury rooms; €110/night (1 night) tiered down to €90/night (4+ nights); Sombrero room with kitchen €120; breakfast optional at €20; in centrum.

sources.title: TripAdvisor — Mi Casa Naranja
sources.claim: Mi Casa Naranja: 4.9/5 (8 reviews), ~$141-144/night, Cuchara approximately 4 minutes away, walkability 76/100, pet-friendly with hearty included breakfast.

sources.title: Lodging-World — Mi Casa Naranja
sources.claim: Mi Casa Naranja booking aggregator listing shows entry prices from €79 and confirms Molsekiezel 24 location.

sources.title: B&B 't Wilgenhuys — official
sources.claim: B&B 't Wilgenhuys: Jacob Smitsdreef 2, 3920 Lommel; described as 'only a few minutes from the centre', breakfast in room or on terrace, forest-adjacent.

sources.title: TripAdvisor — 't Wilgenhuys
sources.claim: B&B 't Wilgenhuys: 4.9/5 (13 reviews), 4 rooms, $128-$148/night; quiet location, #2 of 7 B&Bs in Lommel; Travellers' Choice award.

sources.title: Visit Limburg — 't Wilgenhuys
sources.claim: Visit Limburg lists 't Wilgenhuys with cycling/walking routes nearby; B&B sits ~2 km from Lommel centre, coordinates 51.25085, 5.31222.

sources.title: TripAdvisor — Ars Vivendi
sources.claim: B&B Ars Vivendi: Werkplaatsen 47, in Lommel-Werkplaatsen 'just a 10 minute drive from the centre'; hosts Ann and Guido; 1904 villa, guests since 2014.

sources.title: B&B Ars Vivendi — official
sources.claim: B&B Ars Vivendi: Werkplaatsen 47, three guest rooms (two-person each), private bathrooms with rain showers or bathtubs; garden setting in former engineer's villa.

sources.title: Zenhotels — Hotel Lommelhof
sources.claim: Hotel Lommelhof: Molsekiezel 95, 29 rooms; 2-star; free breakfast, restaurant, garden; informal pricing around US$177/night.

sources.title: Visit Lommel — Overnight directory
sources.claim: Visit Lommel's official overnight directory lists hotels (Corbie Lommel City, Corbie Lommel Ring, Center Parcs De Vossemeren), B&Bs ('t Klijne Huys, Ars Vivendi, De Watering) and various apartments.
